summary: Full backend + frontend regression of ORIVO's Decision Intelligence repositioning. Added 9 new pytest cases for dashboard/advisor/decisions endpoints. 28/29 backend tests pass (1 intentionally skipped). Frontend onboarding -> login -> OTP verify -> birth-details -> dashboard flow verified end-to-end. New Dashboard, Insights, Advisor, Profile, Outlook, Numerology, Packages, Quiz screens all render with correct business vocabulary, dark-first palette, and required testIDs. Advisor LLM chat returns real Claude replies with no forbidden astrology vocabulary. Vocabulary lint across 7 screens: 0 forbidden words, 0 legacy labels.

issues: Copy reads 'not your horoscope' — although used in a negation/positioning sense, the word 'horoscope' is technically part of the forbidden vocabulary per spec. Consider replacing with 'not your daily prediction' or similar if the rule is strict.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove the word 'horoscope' from onboarding screen 1 copy if the no-zodiac-vocab rule is strictly enforced (currently used as negation 'not your horoscope').

OPTIONAL: Add data-testid attributes (tab-dashboard, tab-insights, tab-advisor, tab-profile) to the bottom tab buttons in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for easier automated tab navigation. Tabs render visibly with labels but no testIDs on the buttons themselves.
critical_code_review_comments: decision_intel.py: PHASE rotation uses ((days % 480) + 480) % 480 -> phase_idx = cycle // 120. With cycle in [0,479] and integer division, phase_idx is always in [0,3] -> safe. Good.
server.py /dashboard/today: cache lookup uses {userId}:{date} string as _id and short-circuits before regenerating — correct idempotency.

advisor_reply replays full user history each call via repeated send_message — this works but each new chat call re-pays for previous user-turn tokens; consider passing history as a single context string for cost efficiency.

advisor_reply session_id = f'orivo-advisor-{user._id}' is per-user (not per-session). Two parallel sessions for the same user would share the same emergentintegrations chat memory; consider including sessionId.
Daily Brief fallback string includes Cormorant/serif heuristics correctly; LLM path validates 40<len<800 to avoid junk.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 9 new tests covering /dashboard/today caching+vocab, /advisor/chat with session continuation + history + auth gate + min-length, /decisions create+list)
test_credentials: Phone OTP: any phone, code 123456 (DEV_OTP_BYPASS=true). Token used for UI testing stored in localStorage key 'orivo.token'.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run creates a fresh phone user (+1555<epoch>) and posts birth-details. UI test created one additional user with phone +15552717049. Test decision row prefixed 'TEST_' for cleanup identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 28 backend tests passing including new decision intel endpoints. The fixture chain depends on test ordering — pytest._orivo_session is mutated across test_advisor_chat_first_message -> test_advisor_chat_continues_history -> test_advisor_history; do not reorder these. Vocabulary check (FORBIDDEN_VOCAB) is enforced on /advisor/chat and /dashboard/today brief. To reach the dashboard in browser tests, set window.localStorage.setItem('orivo.token', <jwt>) and navigate to /dashboard. AsyncStorage in web is backed by localStorage with the key 'orivo.token'. The dashboard /dashboard/today response is cached per user+day; second call returns same id and the same brief text.
